title: fix(plugin-dashboard,i18n): the dashboard refresh button speaks the user's language (objectui#11097)
body:
Fixes #11097

Clause-②: no

The dashboard's refresh button read "Refresh All", "Refreshing…" and the accessible name "Refresh dashboard" in English in every locale. Since objectui#11093 wired the console dashboard's `onRefresh`, that button shows on every console dashboard, so a zh-CN session read English chrome on all of them.

## What changed

- `DashboardRenderer` and `DashboardGridLayout` read the button's three strings from the packs through `useSafeTranslate` (`tt`), the shape `DatasetWidget` already uses for `dashboard.refreshing`. The busy label reuses the existing `dashboard.refreshing`; the idle label is the new `dashboard.refreshAll`; the accessible name is the new `dashboard.refreshDashboard`. Both components read the same three keys.
- `dashboard.refreshAll` and `dashboard.refreshDashboard` are added beside `dashboard.refreshing` in all ten packs (ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt, ru, zh), translated, not English copies. Wording follows each pack's own vocabulary: the verb from its `common.refresh` and `dashboard.refreshing`, the noun from its `dashboard.config.breadcrumb.dashboard`, and "all" in the form its `common.selectAll` uses. The en values are byte-identical to the literals they replace, so the English render is unchanged.
- New pin `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DashboardRefreshButton.locale-11097.test.tsx`: each of the two components is mounted under a zh session and an en session. It reads the idle label, the busy label (after a click, while the button is disabled, then back to idle) and the accessible name. The expected strings are read out of the en and zh packs, not typed in the test, plus a control that the zh values differ from the en ones.
- One changeset: patch on `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` and `@object-ui/i18n`.

## Direction, as ruled on the card

Triage direction (comment 5890772607): new keys for "refresh all" and the aria-label, reusing `dashboard.refreshing`, read through the package's existing translation path in both components, no second copy of the strings. I read "no second copy" as: no parallel string table beside the packs, and the same key names on both surfaces. Two things to know about that reading:

- `tt(key, fallback)` carries an English positional fallback at each of the two sites, the shape every other `tt` site in the package has. `check:i18n-keys` checks the key exists in `en` but does not compare a positional fallback with the `en` value: with the fallback mutated to a different sentence the gate stayed green, and with a misspelt key it went red (mutation controls run and reverted, see Evidence). So those two English literals are not guarded against drift by a gate.
- The alternative is bare `t(key)` with no literal, which renders the raw key on a host with no i18next instance (what `ObjectDataTable` does for `dashboard.refreshing` since objectui#10580). I kept the fallback because that host rendered "Refresh All" before this change. Changing it later is a two-line edit.

## Evidence

Head `fde249dd2`. Every command was run from the worktree root; exit codes were captured before any pipe.

- Pin, with the fix: 7 passed (7). Ablation, the English literals put back one surface at a time (mutation committed-state first, restored with a checkout from HEAD, restore shown by `git diff HEAD` empty and the per-file blob hash equal to HEAD's): with `DashboardRenderer` reverted, the two zh cases under its name fail (2 failed, 5 passed); with `DashboardGridLayout` reverted, the two zh cases under its name fail (2 failed, 5 passed). The en control stays green in both, as it should: the literals equal the en values. Direction observed: red under the reverted surface's own name.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-dashboard/` at the implementation commit: 153 files passed, 1392 tests passed, 6 skipped. That run includes `dashboardFaces.displayLocale-9909.test.tsx`, which mentions the button. The one later commit only re-types a helper inside the new pin, and the pin was re-run on that tree: 7 passed.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/i18n/ packages/app-shell/src/views/DashboardView.autoRefresh-11062.test.tsx` at the implementation commit: 75 files passed, 1221 tests passed, 13 skipped. That app-shell test finds the button by the name "Refresh dashboard" under English and stays green.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-dashboard type-check` after building its dependency closure (`pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/plugin-dashboard^...' build`): exit 0. The first run failed in the new test file under `tsconfig.test.json` (the test config compares the zh and en packs by literal type), which is how I know that config covers it; fixed in the second commit. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check`: exit 0.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` on the 13 changed source files: 0 errors, 16 warnings, all on lines this diff does not touch.
- Gates, all exit 0, run in one pass on the final head (`fde249dd2`) after the last commit: `check-changeset-presence`, `check-control-bytes`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check-changeset-claims`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:unused-deps`, `check-package-self-import`, `check:published-tsconfig-exclude`. A grep for control bytes over the changed files found none.
- Mutation controls on `check:i18n-keys` (reverted, tree clean after): the misspelt key `dashboard.refreshAllTypo` on a new call site made the gate exit 1 with a missing-key finding, so the gate does read the new call sites.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:eager-locale-catalogues` and `check:eager-closure`, reason: both read a built console bundle (`apps/console/dist`), which is a full console build; CI's performance-budget workflow owns them. This diff adds no import edge and grows the eager `en` pack by two short lines. Also not run: the repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the full `pnpm test` (CI's).
- Narrowing declared: the test run covered `packages/plugin-dashboard/`, `packages/i18n/` and the one app-shell test that names the button. The wider farm is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

Read at the source, not filed, not fixed here:

- `DashboardGridLayout`'s edit-mode buttons ("Edit Layout", "Save Layout", "Reset", "Cancel") are English literals, while `dashboard.editLayout`, `dashboard.saveLayout` and `dashboard.resetLayout` sit in all ten packs with no reader (a `git grep` of the three spellings over `packages` and `apps` outside the packs finds none; the same grep for the new `dashboard.refreshDashboard` finds this PR's sites). The node type is registered in the console (`dashboard-grid`), but the console's dashboard page mounts `DashboardRenderer`, so I did not measure it through a public door. Same class as this card (console chrome left English under zh-CN).
- `DashboardRenderer`'s record-count badge reads "records" as an English literal after the localized number; the `recordCount` prop is fed by `DashboardWithConfig`, which the console does not mount. `DashboardWithConfig`'s "Settings" button is an English literal too. Both are dormant on the console today.
- `content/docs/guide/console.md` and the app-shell README name the button by its English label "Refresh All"; that stays true for English and is left as written.
- objectui#11080 (undo keys in the same packs) is serial behind this card on the packs, per the claim.
